name: TwinDesk
subtitle: Your iPhone and computers, working as one desk.
description: The official TwinDesk source. TwinDesk connects an iPhone or iPad to a Mac, Windows or Linux computer: its screen, files, clipboard, notifications, sound, camera and remote control, over Wi-Fi, USB or Bluetooth. Free and open source, no account.

apps.name: TwinDesk
apps.subtitle: Use your iPhone and computers together.
apps.localizedDescription:
TwinDesk turns your iPhone or iPad and your Mac, Windows PC or Linux computer into one desk.

• See and control the computer's screen, mirrored or as a second display, with touch, a touchpad mode and the Apple Pencil as a pen.
• Share the iPhone's screen in a window on the computer.
• Send files both ways, Send to Computer in the share sheet, and the computer's folder in Files.
• The iPhone's photos on the computer.
• Clipboard both ways, the computer's notifications, its sound on the iPhone, the iPhone's camera and microphone on the computer.
• Remote: touchpad and keyboard, gamepad, voice typing. Media controls on the Lock Screen.
• Pair over Wi-Fi, a USB cable or Bluetooth. Shortcuts and Back Tap actions.

Needs TwinDesk on the computer: https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk

versions.localizedDescription: The first TwinDesk for iPhone and iPad: every page of the Android app, native on iOS. Pairs with Mac, Windows and Linux, and with other phones.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: TwinDesk finds your computers on this network and connects to them.
privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: TwinDesk keeps a Bluetooth link to your computer, so its notifications reach you in the background and the session goes on away from Wi-Fi.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TwinDesk uses your rough location (no GPS) only to stay connected to your computer while it isn't on screen. It never stores or sends where you are.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: TwinDesk uses your rough location (no GPS) only to stay connected to your computer while it isn't on screen. It never stores or sends where you are.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Send photos and videos to your computer, and let it show and save them (Photos on the computer, while you have it on).
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Use this camera on your computer (its Camera tab and virtual camera), while you let it.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Send this microphone's sound to your computer, while you let it.
